result:
I've written round 474 (decision CONTINUE): DPG-FIX P0 stage 1, which removes the Store's remaining teal. I made no change to app code, and the store tree is still clean at `58fc56e`.

**Round 473 result**
- C passed every row (C1–C7) in the browser, and gate 473 published `58fc56e` (rounds 471–473). That commit is the new baseline.
- STORE-2c-1 is done (მზადაა), and the two Medium bugs C-R471-01 and C-R472-01 are closed. DPG-FONT-RESOLVE stays open, because 2c-1 was only its token half.
- Two new Lows (a wording note in doc 306 and the code-reviewer's notes on the font test) go to `deferred_low_polish`, owner STORE-2c-4.
- Today is 2026-11-12, so the regression round is not due yet. It falls due on 2026-11-13 and will run first at the next planning on or after that date.

**What the scan found**
- The policy says about 100 teal values. A hue scan (160–200°, every colour syntax, tested on mutants) finds 41 in today's `app/`.
- The policy's "61" equals the scan result for `app.css` at `a8599a2` (2026-11-11, before STORE-2b-3). The design review probably read that older version; I've asked root to name the commit it used.
- The remaining Store teal is all dead CSS, unused tokens, or the stems player modal. That modal can never open, because no code ever fills its stems list.
- The rest is in the frozen legacy Studio for purchased tracks, which the loop must not edit. That goes to Saba as one question in `user-review/questions-round-473.md` Q1; by default it stays until SRW-21 replaces the legacy Studio.
- I split P0 into three stages:
  - **P0-1 (this round):** the teal, plus the gradient and glow tokens.
  - **P0-2:** tokens that are used but never defined. These are visible on the page.
  - **P0-3:** the SpotlightLoader opening animation and the design docs. These need a `product-designer` decision and root's report.

**Round 474 task**
- **A** applies a fixed patch to 4 files (`b-round-473/sketch-474.patch.txt`):
  - teal values become brass token references;
  - the 5 gradient and 2 glow tokens are redefined from brand tokens;
  - the 7 unused decorative colour tokens are deleted.
- **Tests:** A edits 3 test files. The allow-lists can only shrink, a new check pins the gradient tokens, and a new hue scanner gets proof rows and mutants.
- **Checks:** A runs typecheck, lint, the 14 covering test files and `npm run build`, and writes implementation doc 307.
- **Pre-run:** on a scratch copy, the patch turns exactly the 5 expected tests red.
- **Review:** tech-lead approved the patch, and I added all three test changes it asked for.
- **C** checks:
  - the file scope;
  - the hue scan: 20 hits expected after the patch, all on the frozen list;
  - the mutants and the unit tests;
  - a browser comparison against HEAD at 1440 and 1280 (nothing visible should change);
  - a computed-colour probe of the changed CSS rules;
  - the Solo button contrast (8.32:1, calculated only, because the modal can't open);
  - doc 307, the auth guard, and the claims script, which ends in `L58 OK`.
- When C passes, the DPG items become "awaiting design re-review", not done, because Saba's rule needs both design agents at 10/10.

**Other updates**
- The backlog, progress board and `lessons.md` are updated. The progress board had no DPG-FIX row, so I added one. Saba's five DPG process rules are merged into lesson L2, keeping the file at 60 lines.
- New root request: update `.claude/primitives/DESIGN_TOKENS.md`, which still says the brand colour is teal (l.9, l.26, l.108). The loop is not allowed to edit `.claude/`.
- New signal: the stems player is dead code.
- I'll ask root for a bounded frontend-architect check of `app.css` at the end of P0, before P1 restructures the same file.

The advisor was available. I consulted it before writing, and again at the end; its second pass found mistakes I've fixed:
- the "61" claim had counted lines, not occurrences;
- C's teal grep was written so it could never find anything;
- some facts in the task had no re-runnable check behind them.

The claims script reproduces its saved output.
